description: npm only: the catalog in pnpm-workspace.yaml, the root package.json and the lockfile.

rangeStrategy replace leaves an update the declared range already admits to the weekly lock file maintenance, which is also what re-resolves a transitive advisory fix; only tilde and exact pins, and majors, get their own PR.
minimumReleaseAge matches pnpm-workspace.yaml's 7-day floor, which pnpm enforces on resolution and on the lockfile, so no PR here asks pnpm for a release it would refuse.
Majors wait for a tick on the Dependency Dashboard issue: several are held on purpose (TypeScript 7, vite 8, @types/node past the node:22 floor), and their reasons are next to the catalog entries.
The exact pins whose comments say a bump is a decision of its own (Biome, @babel/standalone, Playwright) wait for the same tick.

packageRules.description: Every commit is chore(deps), whatever the dependency type; commitlint accepts only the scopes in commitlint.config.mjs.
